explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/443: is #{k(m-k)} ∩ {l(n-l)} ≤ (mn)^{o(1)} for large m, n? Yes; Hegyvári and Cambie show ≤ m^{O(1/log log m)} for m > n. The statement asserts that for every ε > 0, eventually in n and for all m > n, the intersection size is < (mn)^ε. Requiring m ≠ n is necessary, since for m = n the intersection is everything. Faithful.
